results.address: Perelandra Natural Food Center, 175 Remsen St, Brooklyn, NY 11201

excerpts.text: Nice array of high quality gluten free/vegan options including brands that Whole Foods does not stock. Prices comparable to Whole Foods.

I don’t do the bulk of my grocery shopping here but go here for specialty items. Lots of great vegan and organic options. Staff is extremely friendly and helpful. Only downside is that the market is a bit pricey, but I think they have to be in order to survive.
this place is absolute HEAVEN for vegans. i have a dairy allergy and i love to come here for vegan cheeses, yogurts, treats, etc. can find better prices elsewhere but this selection can't be beat.
